svg.text: • Why DQI [Jordan et al. 2024] Needs Zipper Uncomputation: Coherent Berlekamp-Massey / Euclidean decoding must uncompute ALL

svg.text: intermediate remainder polynomials to interfere; out-of-place Euclidean takes 104,448 Q vs. 9,984 Q (-90.4%) with Packed Poly Zipper.
